name: Human
description: Adaptable and ambitious, humans have no great strengths or weaknesses.

name: Elf
description: Graceful and keen-eyed, elves are natural archers and mages but frail of body.

name: Dwarf
description: Stout mountain folk, dwarves are tough and strong but slow to move.

name: Half-Orc
description: Brawny and fierce, half-orcs make formidable warriors.
